title: BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion
title_zh: BiMoGen: 双向运动文本生成 via 统一掩码离散扩散

paragraphs.en: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen ( Bi directional Mo tion-text Gen eration), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page .
paragraphs.zh: 文本到动作生成和动作到文本描述是人类动作建模中的两项基本任务，二者都基于相同的底层动作-文本对应关系。 现有的统一方法大多依赖自回归建模，这种模式会施加固定的生成顺序，因此难以适应语言与动作之间的双向依赖关系，导致早期的预测错误会作为固定上下文持续存在，进而损害时间连贯性和跨模态一致性。 掩码离散扩散模型通过迭代的双向预测对序列进行建模，为此问题提供了一种自然的解决方案。 因此，我们提出了 BiMoGen（Bi directional Mo tion-text Gen eration），一个用于双向动作-文本建模的统一掩码离散扩散框架。 为稳定训练过程，我们设计了解耦的单元模态与跨模态训练方法：首先通过掩码预训练在配对的动作-文本序列中建立跨模态对应关系，随后通过监督微调使模型专注于双向生成任务。 然而，掩码扩散本身也会引入新的错误来源：模型在训练时使用的是干净的真实上下文，但在推理阶段却会接触到自身生成且可能包含错误的上下文，导致在高度掩码状态下产生的错误会持续传播到后续步骤。 我们进一步引入了生成感知自我纠正机制，该机制在训练过程中让模型接触自身的预测结果，并在早期采样步骤中执行纠正操作，以修正那些不可靠的已确定词元。 在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法在两项任务上均展现出具有竞争力的性能，验证了所提出的两阶段训练和自我纠正设计的有效性。 项目页面请访问 https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page 。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-motion generation (T2M) and motion-to-text captioning (M2T) are two closely related tasks that both rely on understanding the correspondence between human motion and natural language [ 41 , 6 , 12 , 26 , 13 , 56 , 25 ] . Recent work has therefore pursued unified frameworks that address both tasks within a single model, since jointly modeling the two directions promises stronger cross-modal grounding and a more compact deployment. Most existing approaches build on autoregressive modeling [ 21 , 65 , 52 , 46 , 63 ] , which discretizes motion into tokens, concatenates them with text tokens, and trains a Transformer through next-token prediction [ 65 , 21 , 46 , 28 , 20 ] . Yet the underlying causal backbone imposes a fixed left-to-right generation order and provides no mechanism to revise early prediction errors. Once a token is incorrectly produced, it remains in the prefix conditioning all subsequent steps, and the resulting errors propagate through the sequence and ultimately degrade temporal coherence and motion-text consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到动作生成（T2M）和动作到文本描述（M2T）是两个密切相关的任务，两者都依赖于理解人类动作与自然语言之间的对应关系 [ 41 , 6 , 12 , 26 , 13 , 56 , 25 ] 。 因此，近期的研究致力于开发统一的框架，在单个模型中同时处理这两个任务，因为联合建模两个方向有望实现更强的跨模态基础支持，并使部署更加紧凑。 大多数现有方法都基于自回归建模 [ 21 , 65 , 52 , 46 , 63 ] ，该方法将动作离散化为词元，将其与文本词元拼接，并通过预测下一个词元来训练 Transformer [ 65 , 21 , 46 , 28 , 20 ] 。 然而，其底层的因果主干结构强制规定了固定的从左到右的生成顺序，且没有提供修正早期预测错误的机制。 一旦某个词元被错误生成，它便会保留在条件前缀中，影响所有后续步骤，由此产生的错误会沿着序列传播，最终损害时间连贯性和动作与文本的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Masked discrete diffusion offers a more principled alternative [ 51 , 30 , 2 , 34 , 4 , 39 , 1 ] . By iteratively predicting masked tokens from bidirectional context, it naturally captures the bidirectional dependencies between text and motion and avoids premature commitments made under limited information. However, applying masked diffusion to unified motion-text modeling raises two fundamental challenges. First, training a single model for both T2M and M2T entangles cross-modal correspondence learning with conditional generation, forcing the model to produce target tokens before reliable motion-text alignment has emerged and destabilizing optimization. Second, the model is trained on corrupted ground-truth context yet must condition on its own earlier predictions at inference, and this train-test misalignment becomes most severe under the high mask ratios encountered in early sampling steps, where committed errors persist and cascade into later predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 掩码离散扩散提供了一种更具原则性的替代方案 [ 51 , 30 , 2 , 34 , 4 , 39 , 1 ] 。 通过迭代预测来自双向上下文的掩码标记，该方法自然地捕捉了文本与运动之间的双向依赖关系，并避免了在信息有限时过早做出决定。 然而，将掩码扩散应用于统一的运动-文本建模带来了两个根本性挑战。 首先，为 T2M 和 M2T 同时训练单一模型会将跨模态对应关系学习与条件生成相互纠缠，迫使模型在可靠的运动-文本对齐尚未形成之前便生成目标标记，从而破坏了优化的稳定性。 其次，该模型是在被污染的基准上下文中训练的，但在推理时却必须基于自身早期的预测进行条件生成；这种训练与测试之间的不匹配在早期采样步骤所面临的高掩码比率下尤为严重，此时已产生的错误会持续存在并连锁地影响后续预测。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose BiMoGen ( Bi directional Mo tion-text Gen eration), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. As shown in Figure 2 , BiMoGen handles both T2M and M2T within a single model through masked token prediction, naturally accommodating the bidirectional dependencies between the two modalities. Recognizing that cross-modal alignment and conditional generation impose fundamentally different learning objectives, we introduce a two-stage strategy named Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training. The first stage performs masked pretraining on paired motion-text sequences to establish robust cross-modal correspondence, while the second stage applies supervised fine-tuning that specializes the model for bidirectional generation. To further close the gap between training and inference, we propose Generation-Aware Self-Correction that explicitly aligns the two regimes. During training, the model learns to recover ground-truth tokens from its own predicted context, while at inference correction passes are applied at early sampling steps to revise unreliable tokens before errors propagate to subsequent steps. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D [ 13 ] and KIT-ML [ 37 ] demonstrate that BiMoGen achieves competitive performance on both T2M generation and M2T captioning.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 BiMoGen（双向运动-文本生成），一个用于双向运动-文本建模的统一掩码离散扩散框架。 如图 2 所示，BiMoGen 通过掩码标记预测在单个模型内同时处理 T2M 和 M2T，自然地适应了两种模态之间的双向依赖关系。 我们认识到跨模态对齐与条件生成具有根本不同的学习目标，因此引入了一种名为“解耦的单向与跨模态训练”的两阶段策略。 第一阶段在配对的运动-文本序列上进行掩码预训练，以建立稳健的跨模态对应关系；第二阶段则通过监督微调使模型专门用于双向生成。 为了进一步缩小训练与推理之间的差距，我们提出了“生成感知自我修正”机制，明确对齐这两种模式。 在训练阶段，模型学习从自身预测的上下文中恢复真实标记；而在推理阶段，则会在早期采样步骤中应用修正过程，在错误传播到后续步骤之前修正不可靠的标记。 在 HumanML3D [13] 和 KIT-ML [37] 上进行的广泛实验表明，BiMoGen 在 T2M 生成和 M2T 描述生成方面均取得了具有竞争力的性能。

paragraphs.en: We propose BiMoGen, a unified masked discrete diffusion framework that formulates T2M generation and M2T captioning under a shared bidirectional architecture.

paragraphs.en: Text-to-Motion Generation. Generating 3D human motion from natural language has emerged as a fundamental task with applications in animation, virtual humans, and embodied agents [ 49 , 60 , 48 , 62 , 64 , 40 , 7 , 10 ] . Continuous-diffusion approaches model motion either in raw coordinate space [ 58 , 32 , 33 , 38 ] , as in MDM [ 41 ] , or in a learned latent space for efficiency, as in MLD [ 6 ] . A parallel line of work discretizes motion into tokens via VQ-VAE [ 42 ] and models them with sequence models [ 36 , 20 , 22 ] . T2M-GPT [ 56 ] adopts a GPT-style autoregressive decoder, whereas MoMask [ 12 ] introduces residual quantization with masked generative modeling. Despite the diversity of generative paradigms, these methods are tailored to unidirectional text-to-motion synthesis and provide neither motion-to-text captioning nor a shared formulation that exploits the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到动作生成。 从自然语言生成三维人类动作已成为一项基础任务，广泛应用于动画、虚拟人和具身智能体领域 [ 49 , 60 , 48 , 62 , 64 , 40 , 7 , 10 ] 。 连续扩散方法对动作的建模方式有两种：一种是在原始坐标空间中进行建模 [ 58 , 32 , 33 , 38 ] ，如 MDM [ 41 ]；另一种则是为了提高效率，在训练得到的潜在空间中建模，如 MLD [ 6]。 另一条并行研究路线则通过 VQ-VAE [ 42 ] 将动作离散化为标记，并使用序列模型对其进行建模 [ 36 , 20 , 22 ] 。 T2M-GPT [ 56 ] 采用 GPT 风格的自回归解码器，而 MoMask [ 12 ] 则引入了残差量化与掩码生成建模。 尽管生成范式多种多样，但这些方法都针对单向的文本到动作合成进行了专门设计，既无法实现动作到文本的标注，也未能提供一个能够利用语言与动作之间双向依赖关系的通用框架。

sents.en: Despite the diversity of generative paradigms, these methods are tailored to unidirectional text-to-motion synthesis and provide neither motion-to-text captioning nor a shared formulation that exploits the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion.

paragraphs.en: Unified Motion-Text Modeling. Beyond unidirectional synthesis, recent work studies unified models that handle motion generation and captioning within a shared framework [ 50 , 46 , 44 , 5 , 28 , 53 , 47 ] . TM2T [ 14 ] introduces motion tokens and trains separate translators for the two directions. MotionGPT [ 21 ] treats motion as a foreign language and unifies T2M and M2T under an autoregressive Transformer, while MotionGPT3 [ 65 ] extends this paradigm with a lightweight diffusion head to improve motion fidelity. However, the underlying causal backbone still imposes a fixed left-to-right generation order, which is misaligned with the inherently bidirectional dependencies between text and motion. A concurrent work, DiMo [ 59 ] , also adopts masked discrete diffusion for bidirectional motion-text modeling, using an RVQ predictor and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning to enhance motion fidelity and cross-modal alignment. BiMoGen instead focuses on the train-test misalignment and error accumulation of masked diffusion. By introducing generation-aware self-correction during both training and sampling, BiMoGen enables the model to revise unreliable predictions while retaining a simpler single-Transformer design over a single-layer VQ-VAE.

paragraphs.en: Masked Discrete Diffusion Models. Masked discrete diffusion generates discrete sequences by iteratively predicting masked tokens with a bidirectional Transformer, offering a nonautoregressive alternative to GPT style decoding [ 9 , 18 , 16 , 11 , 3 , 45 , 24 , 51 ] . D3PM [ 2 ] formalizes diffusion over discrete state spaces, MaskGIT [ 4 ] introduces confidence guided parallel decoding for image synthesis, and recent works such as SEDD [ 30 ] and LLaDA [ 34 ] scale this formulation to language modeling. However, applying masked discrete diffusion to bidirectional motion text modeling is not a direct transfer. Motion and text tokens differ not only in semantics but also in sequence length. Motion sequences usually contain many more tokens than captions, which can make unified masked prediction dominated by motion reconstruction and hinder the learning of reliable cross-modal correspondence. Moreover, long motion targets amplify the mismatch between training and sampling, since early self-generated errors can persist and affect subsequent refinement steps. BiMoGen addresses these issues with decoupled cross-modal pretraining and conditional fine-tuning, together with generation-aware self correction to reduce error accumulation during sampling.

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional motion-text generation ultimately requires the model to produce one modality conditioned on the other, but conditional generation can only succeed once a reliable cross-modal correspondence has been established. Optimizing both objectives jointly forces the model to generate target tokens before alignment has emerged, which destabilizes training. We therefore introduce Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training (DUCMT): masked pretraining first learns motion-text correspondence over unified sequences, and supervised fine-tuning then specializes the model for the T2M and M2T directions.

paragraphs.en: Masked Pretraining for Motion-Text Correspondence. The first stage jointly models text and motion under the masked prediction objective in Eq. ( 1 ), with the loss denoted ℒ PT \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{PT}} . Each paired sequence is formed by concatenating 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}^{c} and 𝐱 m \mathbf{x}^{m} in either order with equal probability, which prevents the model from relying on a fixed modality order as a positional prior. paragraphs.en: Datasets. We evaluate BiMoGen mainly on HumanML3D [ 13 ] , a standard benchmark for bidirectional text and motion generation. HumanML3D contains 14,616 motion sequences from AMASS [ 31 ] and HumanAct12 [ 15 ] , paired with 44,970 textual descriptions. paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. The bidirectional Transformer follows the LLaDA backbone [ 34 ] with 20 layers and a hidden size of 1024. Motion tokens come from the single-layer VQ-VAE used in MotionGPT [ 21 , 42 ] , with a temporal downsampling rate of 4. We pretrain for 100 epochs at learning rate 2e-4 and fine-tune for 200 epochs at 8e-5, both with AdamW [ 29 ] . Fine-tuning batches mix T2M, M2T, and the auxiliary M2M objective at an 8:1:1 ratio, with 10% condition dropout for CFG [ 17 ] . The self-correction weight λ \lambda is set to 1. At inference we use 20 sampling steps, CFG scale for T2M set to 4, and self-correction at ℛ = { T / 4 , T / 2 } \mathcal{R}{=}\{T/4,T/2\} . All experiments run on a single NVIDIA H100.

paragraphs.en: Comparisons on Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation. Table 1 reports the main results on HumanML3D. Because BiMoGen is designed as a unified model for both T2M and M2T, we focus our comparisons on the unified bidirectional setting, while using T2M-Only and separated bidirectional methods only as references. On T2M, BiMoGen achieves the best retrieval performance among unified models, with an R@1 of 0.555 and an R@3 of 0.841. It also maintains competitive motion quality, with an FID of 0.069 and an MM Dist of 2.733. These results show that masked bidirectional prediction improves motion-text alignment over autoregressive unified models such as MotionGPT and MotionGPT3 [ 21 , 65 ] , while still producing realistic motions. DiMo [ 59 ] reports a better FID, which is expected because it uses an RVQ-VAE [ 23 ] as the motion tokenizer together with an additional residual Transformer for motion generation, whereas BiMoGen uses a single-layer VQ-VAE [ 42 ] . Therefore, this comparison reflects a difference in motion tokenizer capacity. On M2T, BiMoGen achieves the highest CIDEr and BERTScore among unified models, reaching 60.2 and 38.5, respectively. This indicates a stronger ability in motion understanding, especially compared with autoregressive unified methods.
paragraphs.zh: 双向运动-文本生成对比。 表 1 报告了 HumanML3D 上的主要结果。 由于 BiMoGen 被设计为 T2M 和 M2T 的统一模型，我们将对比重点放在统一的双向设置上，而仅将 T2M-Only 和分离式双向方法作为参考。 在 T2M 上，BiMoGen 在统一模型中实现了最佳的检索性能，R@1 为 0.555，R@3 为 0.841。 它还保持了具有竞争力的运动质量，FID 为 0.069，MM Dist 为 2.733。 这些结果表明，掩码双向预测相较于 MotionGPT 和 MotionGPT3 [ 21 , 65 ] 等自回归统一模型，能更好地对齐运动与文本，同时仍能生成逼真的运动。 DiMo [ 59 ] 报告了更优的 FID，这是可以预见的，因为它使用 RVQ-VAE [ 23 ] 作为运动分词器，并结合额外的残差 Transformer 进行运动生成，而 BiMoGen 使用的是单层 VQ-VAE [ 42 ]。 因此，这一对比反映了运动分词器能力的差异。 在 M2T 上，BiMoGen 在统一模型中实现了最高的 CIDEr 和 BERTScore，分别达到 60.2 和 38.5。 这表明它在运动理解方面具有更强的能力，尤其是与自回归统一方法相比。

paragraphs.en: The further improvement comes from SC. With the same backbone and inference setup, adding SC to PT and SFT raises T2M R@1 from 0.514 to 0.555, lowers FID from 0.102 to 0.069, and improves M2T CIDEr from 44.0 to 60.2. These gains demonstrate that BiMoGen benefits from learning to revise its own intermediate predictions. Figure 3 shows the same effect in the training dynamics. At low mask ratios, SC mainly accelerates convergence and reaches a similar final accuracy. As the mask ratio increases, the advantage becomes larger and persists throughout training, especially at t ∈ [ 0.75 , 1 ] t\in[0.75,1] . This regime matches the early stage of iterative sampling, where the model predicts from sparse context and then conditions on its previous outputs. Training with SC therefore reduces the mismatch between training on corrupted ground-truth context and inference on self-generated context, leading to more stable generation in both directions. Figure 4 further reports the SFT evaluation over epochs on both T2M and M2T, comparing training with and without SC.

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness of Self-Correction. Table 5 studies the timing of SC during masked sampling. Compared with Disabled , applying SC at both T / 4 T/4 and T / 2 T/2 improves T2M alignment, increasing R@1 and R@3 to 0.555 and 0.841 and reducing MM Dist from 2.745 to 2.733, while maintaining a competitive FID of 0.069. It also improves M2T R@1, BLEU@4, and CIDEr over Disabled , with a moderate latency increase from 0.55s to 0.67s. paragraphs.en: Effect of Motion Tokenizer. We study the effect of motion tokenizer by replacing the whole-body VQ-VAE with the Part VQ-VAE from ParCo [ 66 ] , which quantizes different body parts with independent codebooks. As shown in Table 7 , this leads to worse performance. We attribute the drop to the increased learning difficulty introduced by part-wise tokenization under masked bidirectional generation. Part VQ-VAE produces multiple fine-grained tokens, and modeling their dependencies with full attention requires the model to learn both temporal dynamics and cross-part coordination simultaneously, which may be challenging under our current model capacity. We exclude RVQ-VAE [ 23 , 12 ] from this controlled comparison, since residual codes mainly model reconstruction refinements over base codes and do not provide standalone motion semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 运动分词器的影响。 我们通过将全身 VQ-VAE 替换为 ParCo [66] 中的部分 VQ-VAE 来研究运动分词器的影响，后者使用独立的码本对不同的身体部位进行量化。 如表 7 所示，这会导致性能下降。 我们将性能下降归因于在掩码双向生成机制下，按部分分词所引入的学习难度增加。 部分 VQ-VAE 会产生多个细粒度分词，而使用全注意力模型对其依赖关系进行建模时，模型需要同时学习时间动态和跨部分协调，这在当前模型容量下可能具有挑战性。 我们将 RVQ-VAE [23, 12] 排除在此受控比较之外，因为残差码主要对基础码进行重建优化，而非提供独立的运动语义信息。

paragraphs.en: We presented BiMoGen, a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. By formulating both T2M and M2T as iterative masked prediction in a shared motion-text token space, BiMoGen avoids the rigid left-to-right order of autoregressive decoding and enables bidirectional conditioning between language and motion. With DUCMT and GASC, BiMoGen improves cross-modal correspondence and reduces the train-test mismatch caused by self-generated context. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show consistent gains in both directions, with competitive performance among unified bidirectional motion-text models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 BiMoGen，这是一个用于双向运动-文本建模的统一掩码离散扩散框架。 通过将 T2M 和 M2T 都构造成在共享的运动-文本令牌空间中进行的迭代掩码预测，BiMoGen 避免了自回归解码中僵化的从左到右顺序，并实现了语言与运动之间的双向条件约束。 借助 DUCMT 和 GASC，BiMoGen 提升了跨模态对应性，并减少了由自生成上下文引起的训练与测试之间的不匹配问题。 在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 上的实验表明，BiMoGen 在两个方向上都取得了稳定的提升，并且在统一的双向运动-文本模型中展现出具有竞争力的性能。

paragraphs.en: Metrics Definition. We follow the evaluation protocol used in prior text and motion generation work [ 13 , 12 , 14 , 21 , 65 ] . For T2M, we evaluate text and motion alignment, motion realism, and motion diversity. Unless otherwise noted, feature based metrics are computed with the official HumanML3D evaluator [ 13 ] , using motion encoder ϕ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \phi(\cdot) and text encoder ψ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \psi(\cdot) . For M2T, we follow prior captioning evaluation [ 14 ] and adopt standard NLP metrics including BLEU [ 35 ] , ROUGE-L [ 27 ] , CIDEr [ 43 ] , and BERTScore [ 61 ] to evaluate the fluency, relevance, and diversity of generated captions. We also report retrieval based R Precision for M2T to measure the alignment between generated texts and the corresponding motions.

paragraphs.en: Table S1 compares different bidirectional Transformer backbones under the same training recipe. paragraphs.en: Effect of classifier-free guidance. Table S2 studies the effect of the CFG scale w w for T2M generation. Increasing w w from 1.0 to 4.0 consistently strengthens motion-text alignment and motion fidelity: R@1/R@3 improve from 0.505/0.795 to 0.551/0.838, FID decreases from 0.323 to 0.070, and MM Dist drops from 3.305 to 2.745. This confirms that guidance is important for masked bidirectional sampling, where the model must progressively select confident tokens under the textual condition. However, further increasing the scale to 5.0 no longer brings additional gains, slightly degrading R@1, R@3, FID, and MM Dist. We therefore set w= 4.0 as the default CFG scale, which provides the best overall trade-off between alignment quality.
paragraphs.zh: 无分类器引导的效果。 表 S2 研究了 CFG 比例 w w 对 T2M 生成的影响。 将 w w 从 1.0 增加到 4.0 能持续增强运动与文本的对齐度和运动保真度：R@1/R@3 从 0.505/0.795 提升至 0.551/0.838，FID 从 0.323 降至 0.070，MM Dist 则从 3.305 降至 2.745。 这证实了引导对于掩码双向采样至关重要，因为在这种采样中，模型必须在文本条件的约束下逐步选择置信度高的词元。 然而，将比例进一步增加到 5.0 并未带来额外提升，反而略微降低了 R@1、R@3、FID 和 MM Dist 的表现。 因此，我们将 w=4.0 设为默认的 CFG 比例，它在对齐质量方面实现了最佳的整体权衡。

paragraphs.en: Effect of semi-autoregressive sampling. Following Block Diffusion [ 1 ] , Table S3 compares the standard parallel sampling of BiMoGen with semi-autoregressive sampling. In semi-autoregressive sampling, each block is denoised in parallel, while blocks are generated sequentially. The results show that parallel sampling consistently achieves the best performance across all metrics, suggesting that preserving global bidirectional refinement is more effective than imposing sequential block dependencies. Among the semi-autoregressive variants, smaller blocks perform better, whereas larger blocks progressively degrade both alignment and motion quality.
paragraphs.zh: 半自回归采样的效果。 继 Block Diffusion [ 1 ] 之后，表 S3 比较了 BiMoGen 的标准并行采样与半自回归采样。 在半自回归采样中，每个块是并行去噪的，而各块的生成则是顺序进行的。 结果表明，在所有指标中，并行采样始终能实现最佳性能，这说明保留全局双向优化比施加顺序的块依赖关系更为有效。 在半自回归变体中，较小的块表现更佳，而较大的块则会逐步降低对齐和运动质量。

paragraphs.en: User Study. We further conduct a user study to assess the perceptual quality of generated motions. We sample 30 text descriptions from the HumanML3D test set and generate motions under the same prompts for all compared methods. We recruit 15 users and present the generated motions in random order. For the comparison with representative text-to-motion baselines, users are asked to select the best result among MotionLCM, MotionGPT, and BiMoGen in terms of motion-text alignment, physical fidelity, and coherence/fluency. For the SC ablation, users compare BiMoGen with and without SC, with an additional “Same” option when no clear preference is observed.
paragraphs.zh: 用户研究。 我们进一步开展了一项用户研究，以评估生成动作的感知质量。 我们从 HumanML3D 测试集中采样了 30 条文本描述，并为所有对比方法在相同提示下生成动作。 我们招募了 15 名用户，并以随机顺序展示生成的动作。 在与代表性的文本到动作基线方法的对比中，我们要求用户从 MotionLCM、MotionGPT 和 BiMoGen 中选出在动作与文本对齐、物理保真度以及连贯性/流畅性方面表现最佳的结果。 对于 SC 消融实验，用户需比较使用和不使用 SC 的 BiMoGen；当没有明显偏好时，还可以选择“相同”选项。

paragraphs.en: We provide the pseudo-code of sampling with self-correction in Algorithm 1 . Given condition tokens x cond x^{\mathrm{cond}} , BiMoGen initializes the target sequence as fully masked tokens and iteratively refines it through masked sampling. At each step, the model predicts clean target tokens under classifier-free guidance, followed by remasking of low-confidence predictions. Here, Remask ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{Remask}(\cdot) follows the strategy in LlaDA [ 34 ] , which remasks the tokens with the lowest prediction confidence. At selected steps in R R , self-correction is invoked by first completing the current target and then revising the already visible tokens, while the remaining masked tokens are left for later steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在算法 1 中提供了带自我修正的采样伪代码。 给定条件标记 x cond x^{\mathrm{cond}}，BiMoGen 将目标序列初始化为完全掩码的标记，并通过掩码采样进行迭代优化。 在每一步中，模型在免分类器引导下预测干净的目标标记，随后对置信度低的预测结果进行重新掩码。 此处，Remask ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{Remask}(\cdot) 遵循 LlaDA [34] 中的策略，即对预测置信度最低的标记进行重新掩码。 在 R 中选择的步骤里，通过首先完成当前目标序列，然后修正已可见的标记来触发自我修正，而其余的掩码标记则保留到后续步骤处理。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our method employs a VQ-VAE motion tokenizer to convert continuous human motion into discrete tokens. As a result, generation quality is still partially bounded by the tokenizer’s reconstruction fidelity and codebook expressiveness, especially for subtle or highly detailed motions. Moreover, the current formulation models motion at the sequence level and lacks explicit fine-grained control over individual body parts, such as hands, arms, or legs. Incorporating stronger part-aware tokenizers and more controllable representations is a promising direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 我们的方法采用 VQ-VAE 动作分词器，将连续的人类动作转换为离散分词。 因此，生成质量仍然部分受到分词器重建保真度和码本表现力的限制，尤其是在处理细微或高度精细的动作时。 此外，当前的建模框架是在序列层面处理动作，缺乏对单个身体部位（如手、手臂或腿）的显式精细控制。 引入更强的部位感知分词器和更具可控性的表示方法，是未来工作的一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: Broader impact. This work may benefit motion content creation, animation, virtual agents, and motion retrieval through bidirectional language-motion generation. Since the model produces abstract motions rather than identifiable visual appearances, its direct risk is limited. Still, generated motions may be used in downstream synthetic avatar or animation systems, so responsible use, consent for real motion data, and disclosure of synthetic content should be considered in deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛的影响。 这项工作可能通过双向语言-动作生成，为运动内容创作、动画、虚拟智能体和动作检索带来益处。 由于该模型生成的是抽象动作而非可识别的视觉外观，其直接风险有限。 尽管如此，生成的动作仍可能被用于下游的合成虚拟形象或动画系统，因此在部署时应考虑负责任地使用、获取真实动作数据的同意以及披露合成内容。
